title: S2-B3 continuous-interaction outcome-blind feasibility protocol freeze
decision: Freeze SW10_S2_B3_CONTINUOUS_PREFLIGHT_V1. Do not adopt either failed discrete conditioning scheme. Before B3 outcome analysis, test continuous causal interaction specifications for coverage and identifiability without reading or computing forward returns.
evidence: MWE-SW10-S2B3P-001: NEITHER_FEASIBLE for both audited discrete schemes; outcome-blind.
rationale: Preserves the B3 question without relaxing the prospectively failed discrete-cell screen.

metadata_json.pass_rule: CONTINUOUS_FEASIBLE iff all eight interactions pass every rule; otherwise CONTINUOUS_NOT_FEASIBLE; no alternate normalization/cutoff search.

normalization.method: per-date 1st/99th percentile winsorization then same-date cross-sectional z-score
normalization.fail_closed: undefined/zero SD is ineligible and reported
normalization.interaction: product of normalized primary and conditioner

metadata_json.factor_semantics: Reuse certified B2 causal definitions exactly; legacy VOL_TURN excluded.
